name: ZAYX
summary: Free, open-source React Native interaction components for fintech apps: copy-paste animations built with Expo and Reanimated.
description: A niche-first React Native interaction library, starting with fintech. Each component is pulled into your project with one npx degit command — no package, no registry — covering flows like a Dynamic Island-style status pill, an edge-swipe quick-actions drawer, a physics piggy-bank savings drop, a crypto pay orbit and quick-pay sheets. Free for personal and commercial projects, MIT licensed.
contains: 10 fintech interaction components (Fintech Island, FinPanel, Piggy Bank, Crypto Orbit, QuickPay, …)
install via npx degit — source lands in your project, no package or registry
built on Expo and React Native Reanimated, some with Skia and Lottie
free for personal and commercial projects
guide, per-component API pages and FAQ
